tool_schemas.name: memory_store
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new memory node in the session’s active database (or in the provided database_id), storing content plus optional title, tags, and arbitrary properties, and returns the created memory with its assigned nkm_mem_ id and timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id is invalid, required fields are missing, additional properties are provided, or database_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified database_id does not exist or is not accessible in this session. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session cannot write to the target database and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the session/database has reached its configured write limits.

session_id.description: Session identifier used to scope the active database context and analytics.

database_id.description: Target database id to store into (overrides current session database context if provided).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the memory node.

content.description: Primary textual content/body of the memory node.

properties.description: Arbitrary key/value properties to attach to the memory node.

tags.description: List of tags for categorization and filtering.

tool_schemas.name: memory_find
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves memories from the session’s active database by free-text query, wildcard "*", a single id in query, or an explicit ids list, optionally filtered by created_after and/or expanded via graph traversal from traverse_from with relation type and depth controls; results are sorted and returned as a cursor-paginated list (limit items plus an opaque cursor when more results are available), and matching items update access analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed or inconsistent (e.g., invalid ids, depth outside 1–10, limit outside 1–200, invalid context/sort/order, or cursor not valid for the current query), and raises NOT_FOUND when traverse_from refers to a memory that doesn’t exist (or is deleted and include_deleted is false). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session cannot read from the active/target database and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds read/analytics limits for the session.

session_id.description: Session identifier used to resolve the current database context and update access analytics.

query.description: Search query: free text, "*" for wildcard, or a single ID string.

ids.description: Explicit list of memory ids to retrieve.

context.description: Return shape: minimal lists, full entities, or only graph relations.

created_after.description: Temporal filter for memories created after this time (e.g., "7d" or "2024-01-15").

traverse_from.description: Start memory id for graph traversal retrieval.

relations.description: Relation types to include during traversal (omit for all types).

depth.description: Traversal depth when traverse_from is provided.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include soft-deleted memories/relations/observations in results.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: memory_modify
tool_schemas.description: Update/delete memories, manage observations/relations. **Operations**: update (properties), delete (cascade), add-observations (append insights), create-relations (link existing). **Atomic**: All succeed or all fail. **Quality**: One substantial observation per session - complete context stories, not fragments.

session_id.description: Session identifier used to resolve the current database context.

memory_id.description: Target memory id for update/delete/add_observations operations.

properties.description: Properties object to set/merge on the memory.

tags.description: Tags list to set on the memory.

update.description: Fields to update on the target memory when operation=update.

cascade.description: If true, also soft-delete related observations and relations for the memory.

text.description: Observation text to append (should be substantial, contextual, and complete).

source.description: Optional source label for the observation (e.g., user, system, document).

from_memory_id.description: Source memory id for the relation edge.

to_memory_id.description: Target memory id for the relation edge.

properties.description: Arbitrary key/value properties to attach to the relation edge.

tool_schemas.name: database_switch
tool_schemas.description: Sets the session’s current active database context to the specified database_id or database_name (creating the named database when it does not exist) and returns the resolved database identity that subsequent operations will use. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither database_id nor database_name is provided, both are provided but conflict, or identifiers do not match required formats. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is not permitted to create or switch to the requested database, NOT_FOUND if a provided database_id does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if database creation/switch operations exceed the session’s configured limits.

session_id.description: Session identifier whose current_database_id will be set.

database_name.description: Database name to switch to; created if missing.

database_id.description: Existing database id to switch to.

tool_schemas.name: database_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists databases visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status. Returns cursor-paginated results ordered by updated_at desc; refuses invalid pagination parameters with VALIDATION_ERROR.

limit.description: Maximum number of databases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: database_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a database lifecycle state. Supports transitions active->archived/deleted and archived->active/deleted; deleted is terminal. Returns the updated database record; refuses invalid transitions or attempts to modify a deleted database with VALIDATION_ERROR.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the database.

tool_schemas.name: session_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single session by id, including current_database_id and lifecycle timestamps. Returns NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist; refuses invalid ids with VALIDATION_ERROR.

tool_schemas.name: session_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a session lifecycle state. Supports transitions open->closed/expired; closed/expired are terminal. Returns the updated session; refuses invalid transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the session.

metadata.name: Neo4j Knowledge Graph Memory
